headline: Executive order aims to help active duty service members and veterans move into jobs in the merchant marine.
what_it_does: This executive order directs the federal government to support active duty service members and military veterans who want to work in the merchant marine, the civilian ships that carry cargo and supplies. No summary was provided, so the specific steps the order requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may get federal support in moving from military service into merchant marine careers.
They may get federal support in finding work in the merchant marine.
